name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
label: Quest
description: Pirate Hats Ahoy!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully adventurer. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society. Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style. And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.
So here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have all 20 hats? I don't believe you, let me see them. They better be in pristine condition!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh you're a darling, even if it did take you longer than I am accustomed to. This shipment should make me quite a bit of money once I've cleaned and personalized these hats. And seeing as I'm always willing to reward work that's well done, here's a little something for you. I suggest that you spend some of it on a bath sweetie.
